**Not built - needs a maintainer look.** No blockers found by reading; I did not build or run it because it replaces `scripts/gate.*` and `scripts/collect-decisions.*`, adds a workspace member `xtask/` (a tool that spawns `cargo` and `git` and deletes files) and a dependency line (`regex`).

**What looks good**
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is bumped 6 -> 7, matching the process files touched (AGENTS.md, `.claude/agents|skills`, scripts).
- Dependency: `regex = "1"` only, already in `Cargo.lock`; the lock gains just the `xtask` package entry. `publish = false`, alias in `.cargo/config.toml`.
- Gate lists in `xtask/src/plan.rs` match `gate.ps1` on main: SLOW_BINARIES (`motion:finish3d`, `motion:pivot5d`, `motion:flow`, `app:center_cut_multiaxis`), BATCH/ALL/SHARED/CLIPPY crate lists, `-j 6`, `--test-threads=6`, ui steps run in `crates/ui`, release adds the motion/app `--ignored` release lanes and the ui snapshot lane, batch skips slow binaries by naming the others.
- Decision collector (`xtask/src/decisions.rs`) keeps every `docs/decisions/*.md` except `README.md`, strips a BOM, appends to `RECOMMENDED.md` under the same `## vX.Y.Z - decisions gathered at the cut` heading, orders by leading issue number then name, and only deletes files after a successful append. It now rejects a version that is not `X.Y.Z` (a deliberate tightening).
- Only `cargo`/`git` are spawned (`exec.rs:36,116`); no test exe is launched or globbed. No unwrap/expect/panic spotted in the files I read. Files are all under 300 lines, with provenance lines. No snapshot PNGs, CHANGELOG.md, build.rs or `.github` changes. Body has `Refs #748`, a `Changelog:` line, and a decisions file.
- The wrappers (`gate.ps1`, `gate.sh`, `collect-decisions.*`) are thin forwarders; `gate.sh` drops `--ignored` intentionally.

**Local results**
Not built: needs maintainer look at `scripts/gate.ps1`, `scripts/gate.sh`, `scripts/collect-decisions.{ps1,sh}`, `xtask/**`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock` (new member and `regex` dependency) first. Trial merge with `upstream/main` is clean (GitHub reports MERGEABLE). The author reports 13 xtask unit tests passing, clippy clean, and dry-run parity with `gate.ps1` for batch, release and a quick sample (Windows only).

**Requested before merge**
None from the read.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The six deliberate differences from `gate.ps1` (listed in the PR and `docs/decisions/748-xtask-gate.md`) look reasonable; worth a macOS/Linux dry-run (`cargo xtask gate batch --dry-run`) by the maintainer, since the author tested on Windows only.
2. `xtask` joins the workspace, so any fork whose tag predates it needs the member line in its process sync (documented in the PR).
3. PROCESS_VERSION announcement on #681 is left to the merging session, as the PR says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: da334d1297ca1895c46b14e1f00bb4893a2d173e -->
**Not built - needs a maintainer look.** No blockers found by reading. I did not build or run it, and ran no dry-run parity, because the PR rewrites `scripts/gate.ps1`, `scripts/gate.sh` and `scripts/collect-decisions.*`, and adds a workspace member `xtask/` with a new dependency (`regex`). Under the review rules, that waits for the owner's decision. It trial-merges cleanly with current main (no conflicts, mergeable).

**Not built: needs maintainer look at** `scripts/gate.ps1`, `scripts/gate.sh`, `scripts/collect-decisions.ps1`, `scripts/collect-decisions.sh`, `xtask/Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `.cargo/config.toml`.

## What looks good (by reading)
- Cargo.lock: only the `xtask` package entry is added (`regex` already in the lock). Cargo.toml: one `"xtask"` member. `.cargo/config.toml` is just the `xtask = "run -p xtask --"` alias. No build.rs, no `.github/` change.
- Wrappers forward every old flag. gate.ps1: `-Tier -Base -Test -Crate -Binary -Exact -Heavy -DryRun` all map. gate.sh: `quick [base]`, `batch`, `release`, `test <name> [crate] [--exact]`, `DRY_RUN=1`. Both `cd` to the repo root and propagate the exit code. gate.sh is bash 3.2 safe (plain arrays, `+=`, no `${var,,}`, no `mapfile`). `*.sh` is pinned to LF in `.gitattributes`. gate.ps1 is plain syntax that works on both 5.1 and pwsh (`& cargo @a`, `$LASTEXITCODE`, `Join-Path`).
- Cross-platform: `Path`/`PathBuf` throughout, `CARGO` honoured, no `.exe` or drive assumptions, git output normalised with `\` -> `/`, UTC log stamp done by hand (no chrono dependency), stdin nulled, output sent to per-step log files. The gate runs only `cargo test`/`cargo clippy` and never launches or globs a test executable.
- Prime Directive: no `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!` outside `xtask/src/tests.rs` (grep found none). The exit code goes through `u8::try_from(..).unwrap_or(1)`, and errors return `Err`, exit 2. Test filter and release version are validated up front.
- Provenance line on every module. Largest file is `quick.rs` at 279 lines (400-line law fine).
- Process: `PROCESS_VERSION` goes 6 -> 7 once, against main. AGENTS.md, the agents and the skills consistently name `cargo xtask gate ...`. The fork-sync list now includes `xtask/` and `.cargo/config.toml`, plus the note that a fork whose tag predates xtask must add the `"xtask"` member line. Body ends `Refs #748`, with `Changelog: none`, and there is a decisions file at `docs/decisions/748-xtask-gate.md`. No CHANGELOG or snapshot PNG edits.

## Local results merged with main
Not built (see above). The author reports 13 `cargo xtask`-crate unit tests, clippy clean, and batch/release `--dry-run` plans identical to the old gate.ps1; I have not reproduced that.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Maintainer decision: accept `regex = "1"` in xtask (no new crate enters the tree) and replacing the gate scripts with a Rust tool. After merging, it is worth running `cargo xtask gate batch --dry-run` and `release --dry-run` against `git show origin/main:scripts/gate.ps1` once yourself, and one real `gate test ... --exact` on Linux/macOS, since the author only exercised Windows.
2. `xtask/src/exec.rs` `Run::new` creates `gate-logs/<tier>-<stamp>/` even for `--dry-run` (gitignored, harmless).
3. gate.sh turns any extra positional argument into `--crate` for every tier, so `gate.sh batch app` is silently accepted as `--crate app` (ignored by batch). Cosmetic.
4. On Windows, running `cargo xtask` holds `target/debug/xtask.exe`; any step that rebuilt the xtask binary during a run would fail to overwrite it. The current gate only runs `cargo test`/`clippy`, so this does not bite today, but keep it in mind for #749 (release port) if it runs `cargo build --workspace`.
5. `PROCESS_VERSION` 7 still needs the #681 announcement by the merging session, as the PR body says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
